curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What do five friends discover after seeking shelter in an abandoned ski lodge?
curatedMovie.description: After a broken leg cuts short a snowboarding trip in the Norwegian mountains, five friends seek refuge in an abandoned ski lodge, only to discover an ominous presence sharing the dark corridors.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Chilling, suspenseful Norwegian horror built on isolation, physical vulnerability, and steady, high-stakes dread.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Its Norwegian mountain setting and abandoned-lodge setup make a focused horror-thriller choice for viewers who like isolation and uncertainty.
